description: This file defines a Flutter screen widget for reading news articles with various interactive features such as text-to-speech, webview display, sharing, bookmarking, and navigating to external links.

classes.name: ReadArticleArgs
classes.description: A simple data class holding the NewsArticle object passed to the read article screen.

classes.name: ReadArticleScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a news article and provides functionalities such as webview navigation, text-to-speech controls, sharing, bookmarking, and external browsing.

classes.name: _ReadArticleScreenState
classes.description: The state class managing the behavior and UI for ReadArticleScreen, including webview control, TTS configuration, and menu actions.

methods.name: _configureTts
methods.description: Configures Text-to-Speech engine with language and speech rate settings.

methods.name: _handleMoreAction
methods.description: Performs actions like sharing, saving, or browsing when the user selects a menu item.

methods.name: _ttsText
methods.description: Compiles the text content for TTS, including a message about paid version.

methods.name: _play
methods.description: Starts the TTS playback of article content.

methods.name: _applyRateAndPlay
methods.description: Adjusts speech rate and initiates playback.

methods.name: _applyVoiceAndPlay
methods.description: Sets the TTS voice and starts playback.
